name: @coding-harness/autopilot-runtime
description: Durable harness-agnostic lifecycle runtime for the Autopilot skill

scripts.build: node scripts/clean.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-native-helper.mjs && node scripts/make-executable.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node scripts/copy-native-helper.mjs && node --test .test-dist/test/*.test.js
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node scripts/copy-native-helper.mjs && node --test --experimental-test-coverage .test-dist/test/*.test.js
